purpose: Prespecified robustness analysis testing whether cross-pair near-duplicate structure materially contributes to near-ceiling within-distribution discrimination.

normalization.case: Turkish-aware lowercase: I->ı, İ->i, then lower()
normalization.tokenization: Unicode alphanumeric word tokens excluding underscore; punctuation acts as separator

representation.short_text_fallback: one full-token-sequence shingle when token count is 1..4
representation.empty_text_policy: empty shingle set; dataset integrity requires non-empty source text

similarity.metric: exact Jaccard similarity on unique 5-shingle sets

clustering.edge_rule: add an edge between two distinct pair_ids when any text-row pair across those pair_ids has exact Jaccard >= 0.80
clustering.cluster_id: deterministic SHA-256 digest of sorted pair_ids in component

cluster_aware_split.pair_integrity: all rows of a pair remain together
cluster_aware_split.cluster_integrity: all pair_ids in one near-duplicate component remain in one outer evaluation fold
cluster_aware_split.feasibility_rule: if the prespecified split cannot be constructed with five folds and every fold containing all ten domain×generator strata, stop and report NOT_FEASIBLE_AS_PRESPECIFIED; do not alter threshold, representation, or random seed

planned_scientific_evaluation_after_spli.training_recipe: identical to COMBINED_V2_PRIMARY_ABLATION_V1 except for the cluster-aware outer split
primary_sensitivity_contrasts: CE cluster-aware minus CE historical pair-aware
SupCon cluster-aware minus SupCon historical pair-aware
secondary_contrasts: SupCon minus CE within cluster-aware split

interpretation_guardrails: Primary benchmark remains the historical frozen pair-aware split.
This analysis is a robustness/sensitivity analysis, not a replacement benchmark.
Near-duplicate absence or a small performance change does not prove absence of all shortcut learning.
The lexical 5-shingle rule targets near-duplicate textual overlap and is not a semantic-paraphrase detector.
No threshold or representation changes are permitted after cluster statistics are observed.
